Body.Content:
The Entry Journal Actual Cancellation feature enables users to cancel actuals created by confirming entry journals. Users select eligible actuals, review them in a system-generated correction journal, and confirm the journal to create reversing actuals. The original actuals are marked Adjusted, preserving the original transactions and their reversal history rather than deleting them.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/actuals/cancel-actuals-from-entry-journals

GA date: November CY2026
